node.title: HGE4 primitive shift-pair orbit aggregate router
node.statement: Multiplicative scaling acts freely on every ordered primitive top shift pair, so SP_h^prim=n O_h^prim; a left-anchored ordered scanner has exactly A_h^left=h O_h^prim records. Hence sum_{h=4}^{H_max} O_h^prim<=14n^2 implies the HGE4 norm-gate target. Equivalently the per-width 7000n estimate asks for O_h^prim<=7000 max(1,B_h). At every official h>=4 row the latter allowance is smaller than binom(n,h), so naive uniform max-degree summation can meet it only by proving primitive emptiness; a nonzero route needs averaged falling-factorial, orbit, or sparse-active-support control.
